repos.summary_en: Hexo Qiniu Sync is an automation plugin for Hexo blogs that synchronizes local static assets (images, JS, CSS) to Qiniu Cloud Storage. It enables one-click deployment with image processing, thumbnail generation, and offline preview support, streamlining resource management.

repos.description: 一个用于重新生成 Cursor 设备 ID 和设置 Access Token 的 Cursor 扩展
repos.summary_zh: Fake Cursor 是一款专为 Cursor 编辑器设计的 VS Code 扩展，支持重新生成设备 ID、修补机器码获取逻辑及设置 Access Token，实现多账号共用同一设备。支持 0.45.x~0.46.x 版本，具备使用情况监控、自动备份配置等功能，适用于 Windows/macOS/Linux 系统。
repos.summary_en: Fake Cursor is a VS Code extension for Cursor editor that enables device ID regeneration, machine code patching, and Access Token configuration to allow multiple accounts on one device. Supports Cursor 0.45.x-0.46.x, featuring usage monitoring, config backup, and cross-platform support (Windows/macOS/Linux).

repos.description: A native macOS workspace terminal organized around Projects and Worktrees, powered by tmux and libghostty
repos.summary_zh: Mori 是一款专为 macOS 设计的原生终端工作空间管理工具，围绕 Git 项目的 Worktree 构建，通过 tmux 实现持久化会话管理，并集成 libghostty 提供 GPU 加速的终端渲染。支持本地与远程仓库、项目级导航、独立分支会话及 SwiftUI 侧边栏交互，提供类 IDE 的高效开发体验。
repos.summary_en: Mori is a native macOS terminal workspace manager centered on Projects and Git Worktrees, powered by tmux for persistent sessions and libghostty for GPU-accelerated terminal rendering. It enables project-first navigation, local/remote repo support, independent branch sessions, and a SwiftUI sidebar interface, delivering an IDE-like development workflow.

repos.description: Assistant for get HTTP ONLY Cookies.
repos.summary_zh: GetCookies 是一款 Chrome 扩展插件，专为突破 HTTP ONLY 限制而设计，可安全获取指定域下的 Cookie 数据。通过自定义 DOM 属性触发 Cookie 提取，支持跨域、指定名称与域名，并通过 postMessage 机制实现安全的跨页面通信，适用于自动化登录与数据抓取场景。
repos.summary_en: GetCookies is a Chrome extension that bypasses HTTP ONLY restrictions to securely extract cookies from specified domains. It triggers cookie retrieval via custom DOM attributes, supports cross-domain access, allows naming and domain filtering, and uses postMessage for safe cross-page communication, ideal for automation and login workflows.

repos.description: Audit log for your Django models
repos.summary_zh: django-audit-log 是一个 Django 模型审计日志库，提供用户追踪、变更记录和会话信息存储功能。支持 Django 1.6/1.7 及多版本 Python，通过中间件自动记录模型创建与修改操作，适用于需要完整操作历史追溯的 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: django-audit-log is a Django model audit logging library that tracks user actions, changes, and session keys for model instances. It supports Django 1.6/1.7, South and Django 1.7 migrations, and both Python 2.x and 3.x, enabling full audit trails for data modifications in web applications.

repos.description: Get Inspired by the World's Greatest Artworks Every Time You Open a New Tab. Extension Available for Chrome, Edge, and Firefox.
repos.summary_zh: Artab 是一款浏览器扩展，每次打开新标签页时展示世界顶级艺术作品，为用户提供每日艺术灵感。支持 Chrome、Edge 和 Firefox，基于现代前端技术栈开发，具备本地存储管理和跨浏览器兼容特性。
repos.summary_en: Artab is a browser extension that displays world-class artworks on every new tab, inspiring users with daily art inspiration. Available for Chrome, Edge, and Firefox, it features modern frontend architecture with local storage and cross-browser compatibility.

repos.description: Full-featured GUI for Claude Code CLI in VS Code — Windows (no WSL) & macOS. Third-party API, MCP plugins, Skills, Hooks, real-time token tracking. Actively maintained.
repos.summary_zh: 为 Windows 平台打造的 Claude Code 原生聊天界面扩展，提供现代化 UI 和自定义 API 支持，兼容 VS Code 和 Cursor，支持第三方 API 接入，显著提升开发效率。
repos.summary_en: A native Windows UI extension for Claude Code that enhances the CLI experience with a modern chat interface, custom API support, and seamless integration with VS Code/Cursor for improved developer productivity.

repos.description: Django template tag for rendering Page objects as Bootstrap pagination HTML
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供 Django 模板标签，用于将 Django 的 Page 对象渲染为兼容 Bootstrap 的分页 HTML。支持 Bootstrap 2.x/3.x/4.x 版本，提供灵活的配置选项如页码范围、前后跳转链接等，适用于 Django 1.2+ 项目，现已归档不再维护。
repos.summary_en: This Django template tag renders Page objects into Bootstrap-compatible pagination HTML. It supports Bootstrap 2.x/3.x/4.x, offers configurable options like page ranges and prev/next links, and is compatible with Django 1.2+. The project is now archived and no longer maintained.

repos.description: Public docs & issues for flow.ci
repos.summary_zh: flow.ci 是一个开源的持续集成与部署平台，提供中英文双语文档和公开的问题追踪系统，旨在帮助开发者高效管理 CI/CD 流程，支持自动化构建、测试与部署。
repos.summary_en: flow.ci is an open-source continuous integration and deployment platform offering bilingual documentation (English and Chinese) and a public issue tracker to help developers streamline CI/CD workflows with automation.

repos.description: Django tools for building nonrel backends
repos.summary_zh: Djangotoolbox 是 Django 的非关系型数据库后端通用工具包，提供标准化接口支持在 NoSQL 数据库上运行 Django。它包含字段类型（如 ListField、DictField）、管理后台适配及权限处理支持，帮助开发者构建兼容 Django ORM 的非关系型数据层。
repos.summary_en: Djangotoolbox is a Django utility library providing a unified API for running Django on non-relational/NoSQL databases. It includes base classes for custom backends, specialized field types (e.g., ListField, DictField), and admin integration to support Django's admin interface without JOINs.

repos.description: Django storage for 七牛云存储
repos.summary_zh: Django Qiniu Storage 是一个专为 Django 框架设计的七牛云存储后端存储库，支持通过标准 Django Storage API 无缝集成七牛云存储服务，适用于托管静态资源和用户上传文件，支持 HTTPS 访问和灵活的配置方式。
repos.summary_en: Django Qiniu Storage is a Django backend storage library for Qiniu Cloud Storage, enabling seamless integration with Django's Storage API to manage static files and user uploads via Qiniu's CDN, supporting HTTPS access and flexible configuration via environment variables or settings.

repos.description: Improved memcached cache backend for Django
repos.summary_zh: django-newcache 是 Django 的增强型 memcached 缓存后端，支持 pylibmc、键哈希/版本化/风味化、无限超时及雪崩防护。通过自动处理键格式、版本控制和命名空间隔离，提升缓存安全性与多环境兼容性，默认行为已优化，支持自定义键生成函数。
repos.summary_en: django-newcache is an enhanced memcached backend for Django, offering pylibmc support, key hashing/versioning/flavoring, infinite timeouts, and thundering herd mitigation. It auto-hashes keys for safety, uses versioning for cache invalidation, and adds flavor prefixes for environment isolation—all with sensible defaults and optional custom key functions.

repos.description: 轻量级的clawdbot/openclaw，支持飞书，钉钉，QQ和企业微信
repos.summary_zh: OpenMozi 是一个轻量级、专注国产生态的 AI 助手框架，支持 DeepSeek、豆包、通义千问等国产大模型及 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容接口，提供统一的 Function Calling 能力。它原生集成 QQ、飞书、钉钉、企业微信等通讯平台适配器，内置 25 个工具（文件操作、浏览器自动化、定时任务等）、记忆系统、Skills 技能扩展机制，以及智能上下文压缩策略，适用于企业内部机器人和团队协作场景。
repos.summary_en: OpenMozi is a lightweight AI assistant framework focused on the Chinese ecosystem, supporting domestic LLMs like DeepSeek, Doubao, and Qwen via unified OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible interfaces with native Function Calling. It integrates adapters for QQ, Feishu, DingTalk, and WeCom, featuring 25 built-in tools (file ops, browser automation, cron jobs), memory system, Skills extension via SKILL.md, and intelligent context compression—ideal for enterprise bots and team collaboration.

repos.description: Seamless integration of Algolia into your Django project.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供 Django 项目与 Algolia 搜索服务的无缝集成，支持自动索引同步、自定义索引命名、字段预处理等功能，适用于实现高性能实时搜索与自动补全。兼容 Python 3.8+ 和 Django 4.x/5.x，提供完整的搜索、地理搜索、标签及多索引支持。
repos.summary_en: This repository enables seamless integration of Algolia Search API into Django projects, offering features like automatic indexing, custom index naming, field preprocessing, and support for geo-search and tagging. Compatible with Python 3.8+ and Django 4.x/5.x, it simplifies building high-performance real-time search and autocomplete experiences.

repos.description: A carefully curated list of awesome OpenClaw resources — not everything, just the best.  Skills · Plugins · MCP · Tools · Deployments · Security · Research · Alternatives。精心策划的 OpenClaw 优质资源大合集 —— 不求大而全，只求真有用。
repos.summary_zh: OpenClaw 是一个精心策划的优质资源合集，聚焦于本地优先、自主运行的 AI 智能体框架。涵盖技能插件、MCP集成、部署方案、安全实践及替代工具，旨在提供实用而非泛化的技术指南，帮助用户快速构建和运行自主 AI 代理。
repos.summary_en: Awesome OpenClaw is a meticulously curated collection of top-tier resources for the OpenClaw autonomous AI agent framework. It covers skills, plugins, MCP integrations, deployments, security, and alternatives, focusing on practicality over exhaustiveness to empower developers in building local-first, self-hosted AI agents.

repos.description: Bird is a cli for twitter, so your agents can tweet.
repos.summary_zh: Bird 是一款基于命令行界面的 X (Twitter) 客户端，专为自动化脚本和 AI 智能体设计。它支持通过浏览器 Cookie 或 Sweetistics API 进行身份验证，提供发推、回复、读取推文、搜索及查看提及等核心功能，并支持 JSON 格式输出，便于集成到自动化工作流中。
repos.summary_en: Bird is a fast command-line interface for X (Twitter), designed for automation scripts and AI agents. It supports authentication via browser cookies or the Sweetistics API, offering core functionalities like tweeting, replying, reading, searching, and viewing mentions. It also supports JSON output for seamless integration into automated workflows.

repos.description: Get a better UI of V2EX.
repos.summary_zh: v2ex.k 是一款专为 V2EX 设计的界面增强浏览器插件，采用 Vue 重构，提供全新配色、左侧导航栏和快速阅读模式。支持主题切换、全键盘操作及 URL 动态更新，显著提升浏览效率与视觉体验。
repos.summary_en: v2ex.k is a browser extension that enhances the V2EX website with a modern UI, featuring new themes, sidebar navigation, quick-read mode, keyboard shortcuts, and dynamic URL updates for improved browsing efficiency and user experience.

repos.description: A minimalist, terminal-style new tab page for your browser.
repos.summary_zh: Neko-Tab 是一款极简终端风格的浏览器新标签页扩展，基于 React + TypeScript + Vite 构建。核心亮点是键盘优先的命令面板（Ctrl+K），集成模糊搜索、URL 别名、内置计算器、标签页搜索、多搜索引擎切换及 AI 命令解释器（支持 OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini）。AI 模块可学习浏览历史、智能解析自然语言指令（如打开多个应用），并支持基于历史记录的问答与日志保存。提供 22+ 主题、自定义 ASCII 艺术和便签本功能。
repos.summary_en: Neko-Tab is a minimalist, terminal-style browser new tab extension built with React, TypeScript, and Vite. Its keyboard-first command palette (Ctrl+K) unifies fuzzy search, URL aliases, a built-in calculator, tab switching, multi-engine search, and an AI command interpreter (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini). The AI learns from browsing history, resolves natural-language navigation, answers history-based Q&A, and saves summaries to a journal. Features 22+ themes, custom ASCII art, and a scratchpad.

repos.description: 一个将本地markdown在尽可能保持格式的情况下复制到公众号、知乎、飞书、X等平台的浏览器插件
repos.summary_zh: Markdown Paste Helper 是一款浏览器插件，可将本地 Markdown 内容一键粘贴至知乎、微信公众号、飞书、X Articles 等主流平台，自动转换为适配的富文本格式。支持预处理语法（如 GitHub alerts、任务列表）、自定义公众号主题色与代码高亮，并提供一键分发功能，实现‘一次编写，多端发布’的高效内容创作体验。
repos.summary_en: Markdown Paste Helper is a browser extension that enables one-click pasting of Markdown content into major platforms like Zhihu, WeChat Official Accounts, Feishu, and X Articles, automatically converting it to platform-specific rich text formats. It supports preprocessing syntax (e.g., GitHub alerts, task lists), custom WeChat themes with code highlighting, and offers batch distribution across logged-in platforms for efficient multi-platform publishing.

repos.description: A jquery and bootstrap basic tree view plugin, easily use.
repos.summary_zh: EasyTree 是一个基于 jQuery 和 Bootstrap 3 的轻量级树形视图插件，可将无序列表快速转换为支持选择、添加、编辑和删除操作的交互式树形结构，适用于需要动态层级数据管理的 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: EasyTree is a lightweight jQuery and Bootstrap 3-based plugin that transforms unordered lists into interactive tree views with selectable, addable, editable, and deletable nodes, ideal for dynamic hierarchical data management in web applications.

repos.description: weui sketch by ZTfer
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供微信官方 WeUI 设计框架的 Sketch 源文件，包含完整 UI 组件库（按钮、单元格、弹窗、进度条等），尺寸与色彩严格遵循 WeUI 规范，支持 750*1334 设计稿尺寸，配套字体与@0.5x/@2x 效果图，助力设计师高效产出符合微信原生体验的界面。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides Sketch source files for WeUI, a UI framework by WeChat. It includes fully designed components (buttons, cells, dialogs, progress bars, etc.) with exact adherence to WeUI's design specs, supporting 750*1334 layout, bundled with @0.5x/@2x preview images and system fonts for rapid prototyping.

repos.description: Generate RESTful json data for Hexo plugins.
repos.summary_zh: hexo-generator-restful 是一个 Hexo 插件，可将博客内容生成 RESTful 风格的 JSON 数据，支持分页、分类、标签和文章详情等 API 接口，便于构建 SPA 应用或前后端分离架构。
repos.summary_en: hexo-generator-restful is a Hexo plugin that generates RESTful JSON data from blog content, supporting pagination, categories, tags, and article details via API endpoints, ideal for building SPA applications or decoupled front-end systems.

repos.description: This is a Django helper for @defunkt's jquery-pjax.
repos.summary_zh: django-pjax 是一个 Django 扩展库，用于集成 jQuery-PJAX 实现页面局部异步加载，提升用户体验并保持浏览器历史记录。支持函数视图和类视图装饰器，自动替换模板为 `-pjax` 后缀版本，兼容 Python 2.7+/3.3+ 和 Django 1.3+。
repos.summary_en: django-pjax is a Django helper library that integrates jQuery-PJAX for partial page loading via AJAX, enhancing performance while maintaining browser navigation. It supports decorators for function and class-based views, auto-swapping templates to `-pjax` variants, compatible with Python 2.7+/3.3+ and Django 1.3+.

repos.description: Django database backend for MySQL that provides pooling ala SQLAlchemy.
repos.summary_zh: django-mysqlpool 是一个基于 SQLAlchemy 的 Django MySQL 数据库后端，提供连接池功能，通过 Monkey-patch 方式无缝集成，避免冻结 Django 核心代码。支持自定义连接池实现与参数配置，有效限制进程级连接数，提升高并发场景下的数据库资源利用率。
repos.summary_en: django-mysqlpool is a Django MySQL database backend leveraging SQLAlchemy for connection pooling. It uses monkey-patching to integrate seamlessly without freezing Django's core, supporting customizable pool implementations and arguments. It helps limit per-process connections, improving resource efficiency in high-concurrency environments.

repos.description: 零代码、一键部署chatgpt到钉钉，无须VPN
repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供零代码、一键部署ChatGPT到钉钉的完整解决方案，无需翻墙即可在钉钉中直接使用ChatGPT智能问答功能。支持个人与企业级场景，集成钉钉机器人实现一对一或群聊交互，适用于客服、办公助手等场景，大幅降低AI接入门槛。
repos.summary_en: This project enables zero-code, one-click deployment of ChatGPT into DingTalk without requiring a VPN. It integrates ChatGPT with DingTalk via robot functionality, supporting both individual and group interactions. Ideal for enterprise customer service and office automation, it significantly lowers the barrier to AI adoption.

repos.description: bootstrap3 validation
repos.summary_zh: bootstrap3-validation.js 是一个专为 Bootstrap 3 设计的 jQuery 表单验证插件，支持多种内置校验规则（如邮箱、URL、日期、数字等），支持自定义校验逻辑和异步验证，兼容 IE8，提供简洁的 HTML 属性配置方式，适用于水平表单和内联表单样式。
repos.summary_en: bootstrap3-validation.js is a jQuery plugin designed for Bootstrap 3 form validation, supporting built-in rules (e.g., email, URL, date, number), custom validation logic, asynchronous checks, IE8 compatibility, and clean HTML attribute-based configuration for horizontal and inline forms.

repos.description: 公众号阅读增强插件是一款 Chrome 浏览器扩展，旨在提升用户阅读微信公众号文章的体验。通过自动生成文章的结构化目录，让您轻松了解文章结构、快速导航到感兴趣的部分，并在阅读长文时保持位置感知。
repos.summary_zh: 公众号阅读增强插件是一款 Chrome 扩展，专为优化电脑端阅读微信公众号长文体验而设计。核心功能包括自动生成结构化目录、图片放大预览、链接智能识别与跳转，以及阅读位置实时追踪，显著提升信息获取效率与视觉舒适度。
repos.summary_en: WeChat Reader Enhancer is a Chrome extension designed to improve the reading experience of WeChat Official Account articles on desktop. It features auto-generated structured table of contents, image zoom-in preview, URL recognition and clickable linking, and real-time reading position tracking, significantly enhancing content navigation and visual comfort.

repos.summary_zh: 基于 FastMCP 框架的 VSCode 扩展，将 VSCode 转换为 MCP 服务器，支持通过 HTTP Streaming 和 SSE 协议远程执行内部命令，提供工作区信息查询、异步执行、命令白名单等能力，兼容 Model Context Protocol 标准。
repos.summary_en: A VSCode extension using FastMCP framework to convert VSCode into an MCP server, enabling remote execution of internal commands via HTTP Streaming and SSE, with workspace info, async execution, command whitelisting, and full Model Context Protocol compatibility.

repos.description: Markdown  在线阅读器
repos.summary_zh: 在线 Markdown 阅读器支持代码高亮、目录自动生成、本地图片显示及导出 HTML，并集成 Todo 列表、MathJax 公式、时序图、Emoji 和 ECharts 图表等扩展语法，提供丰富的富文本阅读体验。
repos.summary_en: An online Markdown reader featuring code highlighting, auto-generated table of contents, local image support, HTML export, and rich extensions including Todo lists, MathJax, sequence diagrams, Emoji, and ECharts visualizations.

repos.description: :zap: :rocket:This is a upload plug-ins
repos.summary_zh: lUpload 是一个基于 jQuery 开发的轻量级文件上传插件，支持拖拽、粘贴、选择三种上传方式，具备实时进度显示、速度监控、多文件队列/并发上传控制，并可自定义文件类型缩略图与模板。适用于需要快速集成多模式上传功能的 Web 项目。
repos.summary_en: lUpload is a lightweight jQuery-based file upload plugin supporting drag-and-drop, paste, and file selection uploads. It features real-time progress tracking, upload speed monitoring, concurrent/sequential upload modes, custom thumbnails per file type, and flexible templating. Ideal for rapid integration of multi-mode uploads in web applications.

repos.description: Qiniu(http://www.qiniu.com) is a cloud storage service, this package interages it with django framework.
repos.summary_zh: django-qiniu 是一个过时的 Django 插件，用于将七牛云存储服务集成到 Django 框架中。它通过自定义字段（如 QiniuFileField 和 QiniuImageField）简化文件上传与管理，支持自动生成文件 URL 和图像缩略图处理。需配合七牛 Python SDK 使用，现已不推荐使用，建议迁移至更现代的 django-qiniu-storage 方案。
repos.summary_en: django-qiniu is an outdated Django package that integrates Qiniu cloud storage with Django. It provides custom fields like QiniuFileField and QiniuImageField for seamless file uploads, URL generation, and image processing (e.g., thumbnails). Requires the Qiniu Python SDK and is no longer maintained; modern alternatives like django-qiniu-storage are recommended.

repos.description: claudeclaw
repos.summary_zh: MateCode 是一个通过 Telegram 远程控制 Claude Code 的桥接工具，支持长期记忆、会话管理、代码高亮等功能。采用纯 Python 标准库开发，基于长轮询实现低延迟通信，所有数据本地存储保障隐私安全。
repos.summary_en: MateCode is a bridge tool that enables remote control of Claude Code via Telegram, featuring long-term memory, session management, and code highlighting. Built with pure Python standard libraries, it uses long polling for low-latency communication with local SQLite storage for privacy.

repos.summary_zh: django-pjaxr 是一个为 Django 项目提供 PJAX 支持的轻量级扩展，通过集成 jquery-pjaxr 实现无刷新页面加载，提升用户体验。它通过模板标签和上下文处理器简化配置，支持自定义模板，适用于需要局部刷新的 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: django-pjaxr is a lightweight Django extension enabling PJAX support via jquery-pjaxr, allowing seamless partial page updates without full reloads. It simplifies integration with template tags and context processors, supporting customizable templates for enhanced user experience in Django web applications.

repos.description: 微信支付的python接口
repos.summary_zh: weixin_pay 是一个为 Python 开发者提供的微信支付接口库，简化了微信支付 API 的调用流程。该库经过实际项目测试验证，支持核心支付功能，适合快速集成到电商、服务类应用中，提升支付模块开发效率。
repos.summary_en: weixin_pay is a Python library providing a simplified interface for WeChat Pay API. Developed for production use, it supports core payment functionalities and has been tested successfully. Ideal for integrating WeChat Pay into e-commerce or service applications efficiently.

repos.description: Yet Another Pair Programming Package for Atom.
repos.summary_zh: Coeditor 是一个为 Atom 编辑器设计的实时协同编程插件，支持多用户无冲突文本编辑、语法高亮同步、文件操作同步及项目级协作感知。通过自建 WebSocket 服务器实现客户端间状态同步，适用于远程结对编程场景，需统一配置换行符以避免内容不一致。
repos.summary_en: Coeditor is a real-time collaborative programming plugin for Atom, enabling conflict-free text editing, syntax highlighting sync, file operations, and project awareness across multiple users. It relies on a custom WebSocket server for state synchronization, ideal for remote pair programming, with strict line ending consistency requirements across clients.

repos.description: ⚡ Excel Plugin Framework | Excel插件框架 - C# .NET hot-reload template for VSTO add-ins. Features: WPF/WinForms UI, auto-update, COM safety, MVVM pattern. Perfect for Office automation & Excel/WPS plugins
repos.summary_zh: BasePlugin 是一个基于 DTI_Tool.AddIn 热插拔框架的 Excel 插件开发模板，专为 C#/.NET Framework 构建 VSTO 插件而设计。支持 WPF/WinForms UI、MVVM 模式、自动更新、COM 安全交互，适用于 Excel/WPS 自动化扩展开发。
repos.summary_en: BasePlugin is a comprehensive Excel add-in development template built on the DTI_Tool.AddIn hot-pluggable framework, enabling C#/.NET Framework VSTO plugin development with WPF/WinForms UI, MVVM pattern, auto-update, and COM-safe Excel interop for Office automation.

repos.description: 🛡️ Workspace file protection plugin for OpenClaw — guards against prompt injection attacks
repos.summary_zh: OpenClaw Guard 插件为 OpenClaw AI 代理提供工作区文件防护，有效防御提示注入攻击。通过拦截外部会话的文件操作，自动屏蔽对身份、记忆等关键文件的读写，并将非关键写入重定向至沙箱目录，确保主会话权限隔离与系统安全。
repos.summary_en: The OpenClaw Guard plugin protects OpenClaw AI agents from prompt injection attacks by intercepting file operations in external sessions. It blocks access to critical files like identity and memory, redirecting non-sensitive writes to a sandboxed directory, ensuring secure agent isolation and integrity.

repos.description: A reusable django application for handling Avatars.
repos.summary_zh: django-simple-avatar 是一个可复用的 Django 应用，用于处理用户头像。支持默认使用 Gravatar 作为头像，自动生缩略图并存储至默认文件存储后端，简化头像管理流程。
repos.summary_en: django-simple-avatar is a reusable Django app for handling user avatars. It supports default Gravatar fallback, automatically generates thumbnails, and stores them in the default file storage backend for efficient retrieval.

repos.description: django动态生成百度地图。
repos.summary_zh: djangoBaidusitemap 是一个 Django 扩展库，用于动态生成百度地图 XML 站点地图，支持 HTML5、WML 和 XHTML 多格式 URL 输出，兼容 Django 内置 sitemap 机制，适用于 SEO 优化与多终端内容分发。
repos.summary_en: djangoBaidusitemap is a Django extension that dynamically generates Baidu XML sitemaps, supporting multi-format URLs (HTML5, WML, XHTML), compatible with Django's built-in sitemap framework, ideal for SEO optimization and cross-platform content delivery.

repos.description: django verify code
repos.summary_zh: DjangoVerifyCode 是一个用于 Django 框架的验证码生成库，支持英文单词和数字两种验证码模式，具备自适应字体尺寸的图片生成与校验功能，适用于网站用户身份验证场景。
repos.summary_en: DjangoVerifyCode is a Django-based library for generating captcha images with English words or numbers, featuring adaptive font sizing and validation, ideal for user authentication in web applications.

repos.description: hexo插件 - 七牛资源同步. 可以在本地存放好静态资源（图片、JS、CSS），然后在md文章中直接使用标签引用，在发布时会自动将静态资源上传到你的七牛空间中，并在hexo生成的静态页面中自动引用这些静态资源在千牛的url。
repos.summary_zh: hexo-qiniu-sync 是一个 Hexo 插件，用于自动将本地静态资源（如图片、JS、CSS）同步至七牛云存储，并在生成的静态页面中自动替换为七牛外链 URL。支持离线预览、增量同步、图片处理（缩略图/水印）等功能，简化博客资源管理流程。
repos.summary_en: hexo-qiniu-sync is a Hexo plugin that automatically syncs local static resources (images, JS, CSS) to Qiniu Cloud Storage and replaces references in generated pages with Qiniu CDN URLs. It supports offline preview, incremental sync, image processing (thumbnails/watermarks), and simplifies blog asset management.
